steps: Play through chapter 1 of the main quest without skipping.
The achievement fires at the chapter 1 finale.

achievements.name: Master Camper
achievements.description: Complete the activation of the camp at Howling Hill.

steps: Find Howling Hill in the north of the Calador region.
Clear and activate the camp — several follow-up objectives unlock once the camp is fully built out.
warnings: Do this early. The camp is your main fast-travel and upgrade hub, and Proud Returnee requires relocating it later.

steps: Progress the main quest to chapter 7.
The achievement fires at the chapter 7 finale.
Clear every main quest chapter, including the side stories attached to them.
This is the story completion trophy and only fires once the whole narrative is done.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Side stories in the quest log are not optional for this one. Sweep the Codex for any quest you have left running before moving to endgame areas.

steps: Open the Codex and find the sanctum challenge list.
Complete every sanctum challenge — each is a separate encounter that must be cleared, not a single fight.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Sanctums unlock progressively with story progress, so this cannot be finished in one sitting early on.

steps: Locate the spire challenge entries in the Codex.
Complete every spire challenge; each is a timed or objective-based climb rather than a standard combat encounter.
warnings: Spire challenges are spread across the whole map, and several only become available after you unlock the surrounding region.

steps: Go to the Codex hunting/new power challenge category.
Complete every New Power challenge — these are fought against world beasts rather than ordinary enemies.
warnings: New Power challenges are gated behind main quest progress. The beasts cannot be fought until you unlock them.

achievements.name: Proud Returnee
achievements.description: Complete the camp relocation to Pailune.

steps: Complete the camp relocation objective to Pailune, which triggers from the Howling Hill camp once the story unlocks it.
The achievement fires when the move completes.
Open the sword challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every sword challenge entry. These are weapon-specific mastery trials, so you need each sword type unlocked first.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Check the Codex weapon list first and see which swords you actually own — a surprising number of players finish this without unlocking every type, then discover the missing entries need a specific drop.

steps: Find Abyss challenges in the Codex.
Complete every Abyss challenge. These are late-game, high-difficulty encounters.
warnings: Abyss challenges require you to have reached the relevant endgame regions first, so they cannot be completed during early story progress.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Abyss challenges unlock progressively with the story. If the Codex entry stays greyed out, it is a story gate rather than something you have missed.

steps: Open the spear challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every spear challenge — each requires mastery trials with a spear you have unlocked.
Find each maze and enter it from the world map or by tracking the maze entries in the Codex.
Solve and clear every maze in the game.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Mazes are marked on the world map, but several sit in regions you cannot reach until late in the story. Do a second pass after unlocking everything rather than trying to clear them on the way through.

steps: Open the constellation challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every constellation challenge — these are navigation and observation objectives tied to specific landmarks.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The constellation challenges are observation tasks tied to landmarks, so you need to physically be at the viewpoint. You cannot complete them from the map screen.

steps: Open the shield challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every shield challenge, which test blocking and parrying rather than raw damage.
Locate the ancient ruins scattered across the world.
Complete the challenge at every ancient ruin — each is a distinct environmental puzzle.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Ancient ruins are easy to walk past because most look like ordinary rock formations. Check the Codex for their approximate locations.

steps: Open the bow challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every bow challenge. Accuracy matters here — these are not damage checks.
Open the secret place challenge category in the Codex.
Travel to and activate every secret place listed. Most are unmarked on the world map, so use the Codex markers.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Secret places are often behind destructible walls, underwater, or require specific traversal abilities.

achievements.name: Master of Rapiers
achievements.description: Complete all rapier and shield challenges.

steps: Open the rapier challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every rapier and shield challenge entry.
Open the two-handed weapon challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every two-handed weapon challenge — these test heavy attacks and stamina management.
Open the gun challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every gun challenge, which test reload timing and weapon handling more than aim.
Open the training challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every training challenge — these are combat drills that must be performed without dying.
Open the cannon challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every cannon challenge — these require positioning the artillery rather than fighting directly.
Open the battle challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every battle challenge, including the large-scale battlefield encounters.
warnings: The late battle challenges require you to have unlocked their regions. Expect to return here after progressing well past the starting area.

steps: Open the special equipment challenge category in the Codex.
Obtain every entry in the special equipment list — these are the named, high-tier weapons.
warnings: Several special equipment pieces are region-locked. Collect them as you explore rather than assuming they can be bought later.

steps: Open the horse challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every horse challenge — these require capturing and training mounts rather than defeating anything.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Horses appear in specific spots and some only spawn at certain times or after story progress. Check the Codex for spawn conditions.

steps: Open the hunting challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every hunting challenge against the game's large predators.
Open the exploration challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every exploration challenge, which cover map corners, viewpoints and hard-to-reach areas.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Exploration challenges reward coverage of the map edges. If you fast-travel a lot you will miss these — walk the regions instead.

steps: Open the operation challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every operation challenge — these are multi-stage missions rather than single fights.
Open the trade challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every trade challenge, which require buying and selling specific goods between regions.

achievements.name: Shadowlord
achievements.description: Complete all Above the Law challenges.

steps: Open the Above the Law challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every challenge in this category. They are late-game combat trials gated behind story progress.

achievements.name: Lord of Honor
achievements.description: Complete all Challenges and Changes challenges.

steps: Open the Challenges and Changes category in the Codex.
Complete every challenge in this category.
Open the minigame challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every minigame challenge in the game.
Open the mastery challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every mastery challenge — these are the toughest trials and effectively gate the completion of the game.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is effectively the last achievement in the game. Expect to bounce between it, the mastery challenges and the endgame Codex categories for a long while.

steps: Open the life challenge category in the Codex.
Complete every life challenge, which involve gathering and observing natural features around the map.
